summary: Anchored, non-modal floating surface with light dismiss, opened from a slotted trigger or an anchor element; for rich content that is not a menu.

usage.text: Put the trigger in the trigger slot, or set anchor to the id of an outside element; a click on it calls toggle(). From script use show(), hide(), toggle() or the open attribute.
The surface is a native popover="auto": an outside press, Escape or opening another auto popover closes it, and the open attribute follows.
anchor is looked up with document.getElementById when the popover connects or anchor changes, so the element must already exist in the document, not inside a shadow root.

a11y.text: It gives the surface no role or name and sets no aria-expanded on the trigger: label the slotted content yourself and set the trigger's aria-expanded from open-change.
Opening does not move focus into the surface; when its content is interactive, focus the first control yourself from open-change.
